caption: The drawing depicts a square textile pattern composed primarily of a grid of squares. The majority of the textile features a repeated design of blue squares with thin white lines and smaller intervening brownish-red bars that form a lattice. At the intersection of each lattice, there are small, solid red-orange squares containing white dots. The squares within the lattice are filled with darker blue shapes arranged symmetrically, giving a patchwork or woven appearance. The lower right corner of the square is depicted as being lifted or folded to reveal the reverse side of the textile, which has a lighter base color with a similar pattern rendered mostly in white with blue and brownish-red outlining. The folded section’s fringe is visible, showing alternating blue and white threads. The entire composition is centered within a light beige border. The name "MAGNUS S. FOSSUM" is printed in small, capitalized letters in the lower border.
title: Woven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
